facts.fact: The article says money largely remains within individual operators' mobile money wallets, with Hormuud Telecom operating the EVC Plus platform.

ITWeb Africa says the Central Bank of Somalia launched the Somalia Instant Payment System in January 2025 to enable real-time transfers between banks, mobile wallets and other channels, while integration between mobile money platforms remains limited.
ITWeb Africa says the Central Bank of Somalia launched the Somalia Instant Payment System in January 2025, on ISO 20022, for real-time transfers between banks and mobile wallets.
